name: claude-plugins-validation
description: Comprehensive validation and management suite for Claude Code plugins, marketplaces, hooks, skills, MCP servers, LSP servers, and rules. Includes 190+ validation rules, plugin lifecycle management (install/uninstall/update/enable/disable), marketplace operations, health checks, security auditing, and GitHub repo validation. Features severity hierarchy (CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT/WARNING), --strict mode, language-aware token estimation, and detailed skill documentation.
